decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby approved shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (15-01-101, 15-01-102, 15-01-105, 15-01-106, 15-01-107, 15-01-108, 15-01-110, 15-01-111, Computer Generated Images, Ref: 3.12, entitled: 3D Massing Studies, received 29 May 2014 and 15-01-103 (Rev A), 15-01-104 (Rev A), 15-01-109 (Rev A), received 24 July 2014.) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby approved shall match those used in the existing building.
description: Erection of a single storey rear and rear infill extension to the house.
